Leaves opposite, 8 - 20 x 65 - 15 cm, lamina with 1 - 3 lobes on each side, margin serrate, apices acute to rounded, base cuneate, petiole 1 - 3 cm long. Inflorescences terminal dichasia; peduncle ca. 7 - 20 cm long
